verdict.rationale: Brevo's developer docs say it integrates with AI assistants via the Model Context Protocol, letting AI models act on a Brevo account. The pricing page adds that campaigns and contacts can be managed directly from ChatGPT, Claude and other AI tools. Missing for 10: detailed MCP server setup and connection docs, a list of exposed tools and their scope, auth details for the MCP endpoint, and independent or hands-on confirmation that it works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Integrate Brevo with AI assistants using the Model Context Protocol. Enable AI models to interact with your Brevo account through standardized endpoints.
Manage campaigns and contacts directly from ChatGPT, Claude & other AI tools
